description: Search open positions. All filters are optional and combined with AND. Returns title, employer, location, hours, salary if published, and links to the job page and the 60-second application (no CV needed).

location.description: City or part of the address, e.g. 'Düsseldorf'

query.description: Words from the job title or employer, German or English, e.g. 'Physiotherapeut' or 'physiotherapist'

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs
